name: Build Linux No Container

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      platform:
        description: 'Runner label (e.g., self-hosted,linux,arm64)'
        required: true
        type: string
      python-version:
        description: 'Python version to use'
        required: true
        type: string
      cuda-version:
        description: 'CUDA version to use'
        required: true
        type: string
      use-arc:
        description: 'Enable ARC support'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
    outputs:
      wheel-path:
        description: 'Path to the built wheel'
        value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.wheel-path }}

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.platform }}
    outputs:
      wheel-path: ${{ steps.wheel-location.outputs.wheel_path }}

    steps:
      - name: Harden Runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@20cf305ff2072d973412fa9b1e3a4f227bda3c76
        with:
          allowed-endpoints: "github.com,api.github.com,api.github.com:443"
          egress-policy: "block"
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          disable-telemetry: true
          disable-sudo: true
          disable-sudo-and-containers: true
          disable-file-monitoring: true
          policy: "default"

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Linux environment
        uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/setup-linux@main
        with:
          use-arc: ${{ inputs.use-arc }}
          python-version: ${{ inputs.python-version }}
          compiler: gcc
          cuda-version: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
          submodules: true
          checkout-mode: fetch
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build Flash Attention
        id: build
        uses: ./.github/actions/build-and-upload
        with:
          python-version: ${{ inputs.python-version }}
          cuda-version: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
          python-preference: only-managed

      - name: Locate wheel
        id: wheel-location
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          WHEEL=$(find dist -name "*.whl" | head -n 1)
          echo "wheel_path=$WHEEL" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Upload wheel artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: flash-attention-wheel
          path: ${{ steps.wheel-location.outputs.wheel_path }}

      - name: Cleanup after build
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Remove source tree
          rm -rf flash-attention
          # Remove virtual environment
          rm -rf .venv
          # Clean pip and uv caches
          rm -rf ~/.cache/pip
          rm -rf ~/.cache/uv
          # Remove CUDA installation
          rm -rf /usr/local/cuda
